factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Income Statement shows profit after tax of DKK 869,196 (2025) vs DKK 10,601,388 (2024).

factual_claims.claim: The effective tax rate increased to 70% from 13%, largely because tax assets were not utilized.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 9 shows effective tax rate of 70% (2025) vs 13% (2024). Management's Review states: 'The high tax on profit comes from not utilization of tax assets (tax loss carryforward).'

factual_claims.claim: No dividend was proposed for 2025, compared with a DKK 6.0m dividend in the prior year.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Changes in Equity shows proposed dividends of DKK 0 (2025) vs DKK 6,000,000 (2024).

factual_claims.claim: Cash generation remained relatively strong despite the lower earnings.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management's Review states: 'Cash flow remain at a strong level.' Consolidated Cash Flow Statement shows operating cash flow of DKK 28.5m (2025) vs DKK 29.4m (2024).

factual_claims.claim: Operating cash flow was DKK 28.5m, compared with DKK 29.4m, helped by improved working capital, particularly lower inventories and work in progress.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Cash Flow Statement shows operating cash flow of DKK 28,460,663 (2025) vs DKK 29,430,925 (2024). Management's Review states: 'The decrease is primarily attributable to the decrease in activity/revenue however it has been possible to improve the net working capital – mainly on inventories and Work in Progress.'

factual_claims.claim: Investing cash outflow decreased to DKK 9.4m from DKK 17.6m, with investments focused on digitalization, software development, process automation and IT infrastructure.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Cash Flow Statement shows investing cash flow of DKK -9,374,141 (2025) vs DKK -17,593,686 (2024). Management's Review states: 'Main investments have been boosting digitalization (lead generation, software development, support to process automation etc) and full update of the IT network and firewall setup.'

factual_claims.claim: Cash increased by DKK 0.6m to DKK 4.0m.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Cash Flow Statement shows cash and cash equivalents increased by DKK 0.6m to DKK 4,009,029 (2025) from DKK 3,424,718 (2024).

factual_claims.claim: Net interest-bearing debt rose to DKK 38.7m from DKK 36.7m, and gearing increased to 1.7 from 1.2 but remained below the target of 2.0.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management's Review states: 'Net interest-bearing debt at the end of 2025 amounted to DKK 38.7m (End of 2024: DKK 36.7m)... Financial gearing calculated as NIBD/EBITDA amounted to 1.7 at the end of 2025. (End of 2024: 1.2). The target is to be below 2.0.'

factual_claims.claim: Equity decreased to DKK 32.5m from DKK 36.6m, with the net-cash equity ratio at 23.5%, below the target of 25%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Balance Sheet shows equity of DKK 32,472,860 (2025) vs DKK 36,634,652 (2024). Management's Review states: 'At the end of 2025, equity amounted to DKK 32.5m (End of 2024: DKK 36.6), equivalent to an equity ratio of 23.5% (net cash). The target is to be above 25%.'

factual_claims.claim: Market activity improved during the second half as interest rates stabilized, particularly in non-residential construction, while residential demand remained subdued.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management's Review states: 'As interest rates stabilized during 2025, market activity improved, particularly in the second half of the year... Within the non-residential segment, project execution accelerated as business cases became more financially attractive. In contrast, demand in the residential market remained more subdued... WindowMaster’s primary exposure is to the non-residential segment and, to a lesser extent, indirectly to residential construction through large key accounts.'

factual_claims.claim: For 2026, management expects organic revenue growth of 7–14% to DKK 290–310m and EBITDA of DKK 45–55m, with conditions expected to improve gradually despite continued economic, geopolitical and project-timing uncertainty.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management's Review Outlook section states: 'In 2026, revenue is expected to grow organically in range from 7% to 14% to DKK 290-310m, while EBITDA is expected to increase to DKK 45-55m... The outlook for 2026 is characterized by a high degree of uncertainty, particularly within the project business... Unforeseen events such as geopolitical uncertainty and supply disruptions may impact developments in 2026.'
